args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 2 flagged, 6 cleared.
Flagged as summary_outlier: r05 and r06. Their profile has a different shape from the rest of the batch. The largest flank difference is at 295 µm, against the batch median of 84 µm (z 6.78). The largest width-free ratio is negative: -0.035, against a median of 0.079 (z -5.28). Their REGR peak is only 0.12 %/h higher, which is negligible. The large z (8.09) comes from the batch MAD being very small.
Cleared: r01, r02, r03, r04, r07 and r08. All pass rigid-body invariance and closure. Plane sections passed or was not run. REGR peak, peak position and growth-zone length match the batch. The flank-difference shift in r04 and r08 is moderate (z 2.4).
What the flagged runs share: identical checks, settings and summaries. Both used tissue registration from 400 px and the width-free ratio, and all their checks pass. r04 has the same remedies and gives a normal profile, so those remedies alone don't explain the different flank-difference and width-free-ratio profile. The cause should be looked at directly.
